source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing and Shell unite for 2026 FIA WEC season
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named Shell as its Official Performance and Innovation Partner for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC)
source.note: Same release: 'branding on the GMR-001 Hypercar at each FIA WEC race' (position not stated, listed as partner). The release's own dateline says 'March 25, 2025' (typo on the page); the newsroom lists it as published 25 March 2026.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing partners with Bang & Olufsen for debut FIA WEC season
source.quote: Bang & Olufsen branding will appear prominently on the sides on the pair of GMR-001 Hypercars that will be on track and the overalls and clothing for the drivers and staff
source.note: Official Sound Partner; brand on the sides of the two GMR-001 Hypercars (sleeve used for the car side, mirroring the Cadillac F1 kit) and on team overalls and clothing.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing announces South Korean brand Helinox as partner for 2026 FIA WEC season
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has appointed South Korean brand Helinox as its Official Outdoor Furniture Partner for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship
source.note: Official Outdoor Furniture Partner: chairs and cots for the team, plus a fan range.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing chooses HEXIS as Technical Partner
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named French company HEXIS as a Technical Partner for the forthcoming FIA World Endurance Championship season
source.note: Technical Partner: produces and applies the self-adhesive film forming the GMR-001 livery.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing appoints New Era as official headwear partner
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named New Era as the team’s Official Headwear Partner for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship season

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing to use Kappa apparel for 2026 FIA WEC season
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named Italian brand Kappa as its Official Apparel Partner for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship season
source.note: Official Apparel Partner (teamwear); the page prints the brand as Kappa with a registered mark.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing to work with performance footwear brand APL for 2026 FIA WEC season
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named Los Angeles-based company APL as their Official Luxury Footwear Partner for their first season in the FIA World Endurance Championship

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing begins collaboration with Le Mans-based Racing & Emotion
source.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has named Le Mans-based design house Racing & Emotion as an Official Licensing Partner
source.note: Official Licensing Partner: bespoke furniture, collectibles and art in the team livery.

source.name: Hyundai Motorsport: Partners & Sponsors - Genesis Magma Racing (Technical Partners)
source.quote: Technical Partners Sparco Since 1977, Sparco S.p.A. has been developing and manufacturing equipment for the racing environment
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. Sparco appears under 'Genesis Magma Racing Partners > Technical Partners'; no individual Genesis-Sparco announcement found.

source.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing reveals GMR-001 Hypercar for 2026 FIA WEC season
source.quote: the first GMR-001 Hypercar chassis were built to the LMDh technical regulations by chassis partners ORECA
source.note: Chassis partner (Genesis is ORECA's customer); ORECA is listed under 'Genesis Magma Racing Partners > Technical Partners' on the Hyundai Motorsport partners page.

summary: 2026 WEC season (GMR-001 Hypercar). Factory team of Genesis, Hyundai Motor Group's luxury marque: the team name carries no commercial title sponsor, only the manufacturer's brand, and its cars run a pure manufacturer livery. Partner roster per the Hyundai Motorsport partners page and Genesis's own announcements: Shell (Official Performance & Innovation Partner, lubricants; brand on the car), Bang & Olufsen (Official Sound Partner; brand on the car sides and team clothing), Helinox (outdoor furniture), APL (footwear), Kappa (teamwear), New Era (headwear) and Racing & Emotion (licensed collectibles), plus technical partners Sparco (racewear), ORECA (chassis) and HEXIS (livery film). Michelin tyres and the Bosch hybrid unit are series-spec suppliers named in the team's own technical specification; WEC series partners are covered at league level.
